## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r DESeq2}
library(Seurat) 
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
library(DESeq2)

#read the .rds file
data <- readRDS("/Volumes/My Passport/Final Data/HarmonyIntegrated_annotated_data_final.rds")

data$CellTypes <- Idents(data)

#filter
#change filter conditions based on the file
seu.filtered <- subset(data, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 &
                         nCount_RNA > 800 & 
                         percent.mt < 5 
)

# run Seurat's standard workflow steps
seu.filtered <- NormalizeData(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- ScaleData(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- RunPCA(seu.filtered)
ElbowPlot(seu.filtered)
seu.filtered <- RunUMAP(seu.filtered, dims = 1:20)

p1 <- DimPlot(seu.filtered, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 5)

# pseudo-bulk workflow -----------------
# Acquiring necessary metrics for aggregation across cells in a sample
# 1. counts matrix - sample level
# counts aggregate to sample level
#see if we need to do this 

seu.filtered$samples <- paste0(seu.filtered$orig.ident, seu.filtered$CellTypes)

cts <- AggregateExpression(seu.filtered, 
                           group.by = c("CellTypes", "sample"),
                           assays = 'RNA',
                           slot = "counts",
                           return.seurat = FALSE)

cts <- cts$RNA

# transpose
cts.t <- t(cts)

# convert to data.frame
cts.t <- as.data.frame(cts.t)

# get values where to split
splitRows <- gsub('_.*', '', rownames(cts.t))

# split data.frame
cts.split <- split.data.frame(cts.t,
                              f = factor(splitRows))

# fix colnames and transpose
cts.split.modified <- lapply(cts.split, function(x){
  rownames(x) <- gsub('.*_(.*)_', '\\1', rownames(x))
  t(x)
})

```

## DESeq2 for AT2

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r AT2}
# Let's run DE analysis with AT2
# 1. Get counts matrix
counts_at2 <- cts.split.modified$`AT2`

#2 generate sample level metadata - do it for each "control" sample vs "treated" sample   

condition <- factor(c("copd", "copd", "copd", "copd", "copd", "nonsmoker", "nonsmoker", "nonsmoker", "nonsmoker", "smoker", "smoker", "smoker", "smoker"))

at2_coldata <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(counts_at2), condition)

# Set factor level
at2_coldata$condition <- relevel(at2_coldata$condition, ref = "nonsmoker") 

# perform DESeq2 --------
# Create DESeq2 object   
at2_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_at2,
                                  colData = at2_coldata,
                                  design = ~ condition)

# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(at2_dds)) >=10
at2_dds <- at2_dds[keep,]

# run DESeq2
at2_dds <- DESeq(at2_dds)

# Generate results object 
res1 <- results(at2_dds, name = "condition_copd_vs_nonsmoker")
summary(res1)

res2 <- results(at2_dds, name = "condition_smoker_vs_nonsmoker")
summary(res2)

#Generate the significant gene

Sig_res1 <- subset(res1, padj < 0.05)
summary(Sig_res1)

Sig_res2 <- subset(res2, padj < 0.05)
summary(Sig_res2)

# Set factor level to smoker
at2_coldata$condition <- relevel(at2_coldata$condition, ref = "smoker") 

# perform DESeq2 --------
# Create DESeq2 object   
at2_dds_1 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts2_at,
                                   colData = at2_coldata,
                                   design = ~ condition)


# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(at2_dds_1)) >=10
at2_dds_1 <- at2_dds_1[keep,]

# run DESeq2
at2_dds_1 <- DESeq(at2_dds_1)

# Generate results object
res3 <- results(at2_dds_1, name = "condition_copd_vs_smoker")
summary(res3)

```

#DESeq2 for B cells
```{r B cells}

#B CELLS

# Let's run DE analysis with B cells
# 1. Get counts matrix
counts_b <- cts.split.modified$`B cells`

#2 generate sample level metadata - do it for each "control" sample vs "treated" sample   

counts.t <- t(counts_b)
counts.t <- as.data.frame(cts.t)
condition <- factor(c("copd", "copd", "copd", "copd", "nonsmoker","nonsmoker", "nonsmoker", "nonsmoker", "smoker", "smoker", "smoker"))
b_coldata <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(counts_b), condition)

# Set factor level
b_coldata$condition <- relevel(b_coldata$condition, ref = "nonsmoker") 

# perform DESeq2 --------
# Create DESeq2 object   
b_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_b,
                                colData = b_coldata,
                                design = ~ condition)


# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(b_dds)) >=10
b_dds <- b_dds[keep,]

# run DESeq2
b_dds <- DESeq(b_dds)

# Check the coefficients for the comparison
resultsNames(b_dds)

# Generate results object
res10 <- results(b_dds, name = "condition_copd_vs_nonsmoker")
summary(res10)

#Significantly differentially regulated
Sig_res10 <- subset(res10, padj < 0.05)
summary(Sig_res10)

res11 <- results(b_dds, name = "condition_smoker_vs_nonsmoker")
summary(res11)

# Set factor level to smoker
b_coldata$condition <- relevel(b_coldata$condition, ref = "smoker") 

# perform DESeq2 --------
# Create DESeq2 object   
b_dds_1 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_b,
                                   colData = b_coldata,
                                   design = ~ condition)

# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(b_dds_1)) >=10
b_dds_1 <- b_dds_1[keep,]

# run DESeq2

#Significantly differentially regulated

```

```{r PC}
# perform DESeq2 --------
# Create DESeq2 object   
pc_dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_pc,
                                 colData = pc_coldata,
                                 design = ~ condition)


# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(pc_dds)) >=10
pc_dds <- pc_dds[keep,]

# run DESeq2
pc_dds <- DESeq(pc_dds)

# Check the coefficients for the comparison
resultsNames(pc_dds)

# Generate results object
res31 <- results(pc_dds, name = "condition_copd_vs_nonsmoker")
summary(res31)

#Significant DEG

Sig_res31 <- subset(res31, padj < 0.05)
summary(Sig_res31)

res32 <- results(pc_dds, name = "condition_smoker_vs_nonsmoker")
summary(res32)

#Significant DEG

Sig_res32 <- subset(res32, padj < 0.05)
summary(Sig_res32)

# Set factor level to smoker
pc_coldata$condition <- relevel(pc_coldata$condition, ref = "smoker") 

# perform DESeq2 --------
# Create DESeq2 object   
pc_dds_1 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_pc,
                                   colData = pc_coldata,
                                   design = ~ condition)


# filter
keep <- rowSums(counts(pc_dds_1)) >=10
pc_dds_1 <- pc_dds_1[keep,]

# run DESeq2
pc_dds_1 <- DESeq(pc_dds_1)

# Generate results object
res33 <- results(pc_dds_1, name = "condition_copd_vs_smoker")
summary(res33)

#Significant DEG

Sig_res33 <- subset(res33, padj < 0.05)
summary(Sig_res33)

```
